entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back. I... I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I just... I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I'm so disappointed this didn't work out.

Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. I thought they would be perfect, but they keep giving me terrible blisters. I've tried different socks, I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but nothing helps. It's just painful to ride in them.

Getting blisters from new cycling shoes is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. That sounds very uncomfortable, and I completely understand wanting to send them back. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Okay... I was just so worried I was stuck with them. With money being tight, I really needed this to work out.
I understand. Let's see... okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase was 61 days ago, which is well within our 90-day standard return policy. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much, David.

You are very welcome. I'm happy to help. I have just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
